review: Manual image review by the primary agent and an independent agent, with rendered geometry, contrast and keyboard assertions in Chromium.

screenshots.notes: At hour 6 the circle and diamond align with the guide and model values. The 0–100 and 0–24 axes align with gridlines. Control 20.7, trial 16.7 and difference -4.0 are legible, and the hour-24 tick stays on one line.
At hour 24 both selected markers are visible at the upper/right boundary, with space around the plot. The guide and selected-hour values agree, and the 24 tick remains on one line.
At hour zero the coincident curves retain an open circle around the smaller diamond. The guide aligns with the left boundary, both values are 5.0 and the difference is 0.0.
Axes, guide and shape markers remain legible at 320px. All hour ticks stay on one line, readout cards stack, and selector focus is visible without horizontal overflow.
At 400% enlargement the chart and stacked readout cards fit the narrow view. Labels remain readable and aligned, both marker shapes retain their proportions, and keyboard focus is visible.

The white forced-color canvas uses a dark dashed control, system-colored solid trial and dark dashed guide. Curves, outlined marker shapes, text and numeric cards remain visible. Chromium also measures at least 3:1 curve/guide contrast in dark and light forced-color palettes.
